stem: Pointing to a man, Priya said, "He is the husband of the daughter of my father's only daughter." How is the man related to Priya?

verdicts.working: Priya is her father's only daughter. The daughter of that daughter is Priya's daughter, whose husband is Priya's son-in-law.
